home.title: A special place.
home.subtitle: All for Nayleen.
home.intro: Filled with games to play. Collectibles of our shared memories. A princess Epurr to dress up. And a whole year of the moments I love sharing with you.

wardrobe.unlock: A new outfit for my princess! {{names}} ♡

weekly.title: One little surprise, every week.
weekly.doneCopy: Your next mystery box arrives next Wednesday. Come back for a new little friend.
weekly.resumeCopy: Your little surprise is still tucked inside. Shaking never changes which collectible is waiting.

games.title: Your favorite little escapes
games.weekly: WEEKLY GAME · ONE RUN PER WEEK

cards.title: Nayleen’s Gambling Paradise
cards.intro: Hit, stay, double down. A lucky little table for my favorite girl.
cards.rules: Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Aces count as 1 or 11. Dealer draws to 17. Everything here is pretend. Reach a best score of 200 to unlock Sunday’s outfit.
cards.resetHint: Your best score and earned outfits stay with you. Reset between hands whenever you need a fresh start.
cards.win: That’s my lucky princess! You won this hand. ♡
cards.tie: A royal tie. Your score stays with you.
cards.bust: A little over 21. Espurr believes in your next hand.
cards.lose: The dealer got this one. Another little lucky streak is waiting.
cards.low: Your score is too low for that bet. Use Reset my table for a fresh 100.

blind.title: Weekly blind box
blind.intro: One collectible each week, with no rerolls just how a gambler likes it.
blind.rules: Your collectible is chosen once and saved inside this box. Shake it as much as you like. You get one opening each week.
blind.ribbon: The ribbon is loose. Time to meet what’s inside.
blind.duplicate: You found another {{name}}. It’s already in your collection. No extra draw this time. ♡
blind.locked: This week’s box is already opened. A new box arrives next Wednesday.

peanut.title: The Peanut Factory
peanut.intro: Squish, hire tiny helpers, and build a crunchy little empire.

manor.title: Ann is looking for you
manor.intro: Repair three ciphers to unlock the exit. Find one weekly collectible and a crunchy peanut while Ann wanders the garden.

scrapbook.title: My favorite moments have you in them.
scrapbook.intro: A little highlight from each week together.
scrapbook.pageIntro: Each week I'll upload this page with little highlights, the things that made me smile, and the moments I want to keep with you.
scrapbook.heading: Our weeks together
scrapbook.empty: A little moment still to come
scrapbook.footer: Collected with love, one week at a time. ♡

collection.title: Princess collection
collection.intro: Tap one of the four shelves beside Espurr to arrange your favorites.
collection.chooseIntro: Choose one of your collectibles for this shelf. You can rearrange it whenever you like.
collection.empty: Your weekly box and the maze are where little friends can be found.

backup.downloaded: Backup downloaded. Keep it somewhere you can find again, or restore it on another device.
backup.restored: Backup restored. Your little treasures are home.

peanut.title: The Peanut Factory.
peanut.intro: One very crunchy peanut. A growing team of tiny helpers. A princess with absolutely no plans to stop squishing.
peanut.shopTitle: A little help for the princess
peanut.shopIntro: Buy upgrades with your crunches. Helpers keep working while you’re away, for up to four hours.
peanut.combo: {{count}} happy squishes in a row. {{left}} until your next bonus.
peanut.bonus: A perfect little crunch streak! +10 bonus crunches ♡
peanut.encouragement: Espurr has appointed you chief peanut officer. She believes in you.
peanut.working: Your helpers have clocked in. Espurr says you deserve a little break whenever you want one.
peanut.proud: A whole peanut empire. Espurr is wearing her proudest little crown.
peanut.masteryDone: Peanut master! Your tiny factory is thriving. ♡
peanut.footer: A very crunchy little love letter, for Nayleen. ♡
